mechanism: Environmental escalation is legible when one contiguous front grows through a fixed geography and each phase occupies a larger measurable area. Static anchors must remain visible long enough to prove propagation, and the final wide state should show that the environment—not merely exposure or color grading—has materially changed.

invariants.rule: Establish a bounded environment, an untouched region and one localized starting front.
invariants.purpose: Defines the area available for change.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on a fully transformed field removes progression.

invariants.rule: Grow one contiguous front instead of spawning unrelated effects everywhere.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random flashes create spectacle without a readable process.

invariants.rule: Cross at least two fixed spatial anchors in order.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without anchors, apparent growth may be only camera movement.

invariants.rule: Increase occupied area and material state, not just brightness.
invariants.ablation_failure: Exposure shifts can imitate escalation without propagation.

invariants.rule: Hold a final wide comparison showing transformed and residual untouched regions.
invariants.ablation_failure: A tight climax cannot verify site-wide change.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

instantiations.concept: Inside a circular aquarium laboratory, one palm-sized blue algae bloom begins near an intake vent, crosses three numbered coral gates, expands into branching luminous sheets and ends in a wide overhead view that shows most of the tank transformed while one clear water pocket remains.
